My family (and the confederacy) originally settled along the St. John river in New Brunswick and parts of northern maine. We now have people all along the river in both Maine and New Bruswick and some as far south as New Hampshire.

My grandparents and that entire generation were victims of the Canadian "residential school" system, and it has had lasting effects on our communities.
